description:
Ask for a mind map and MindMap.Town draws it right in the chat: branches, notes, links, and to-do checklists, in a cozy candy style. Open it in the free MindMap.Town editor to rearrange it, recolor it, check things off, and share it.

Maps are never saved on a server. The whole map lives in its link, and the connector keeps nothing.

defaultPrompt: Mind map the pros and cons of moving to a new city
Turn my meeting notes into a mind map
Brainstorm birthday party ideas as a mind map
